findings.finding: Set BC=1, D=Fₙ/Fₙ₊₂≈1/φ². Solve for incircle radius r so B,K,N,K′ cyclic (root of dist‑R). Compute ratio (CT·NB)/(BT·NE)=2+√5=φ³. α=2+√5 ⇒ p=2,q=5. Answer 2²⁵ mod 99991=57447.

Use incircle: BD=s−b, CD=s−c ⇒ a=BC=F_{n+2}, x₀=BD. Parameterize triangle by inradius r: I=(x₀,r); tangents from B,C give A. Compute E,F, K (second intersect of (AEF) & (ABC)), K′ (reflect K across EF), N (foot D→EF). Circle through B,K tangent to BN at B ⇒ T on BC. Ratio R=CT·NB/(BT·NE). Enforce cyclic K,N,K′,B ⇒ solve f(r)=0 (unique root). Numerically find R=F_{n+2}/F_{n−1}. Hence a_n=F_{n+2}/F_{n−1} → α=lim_{n→∞}F_{n+2}/F_{n−1}=φ³=2+√5. p=2,q=5 ⇒ floor(2^{5²})=2^{25}=33 554 432; mod 99991=57447.
